findings: Empty workbench has one full-width observation track and no task sidebar.
Desktop inbox columns align and eight fixture rows fit in a 900 CSS px viewport; rows with visible review reasons measure 85.921875 CSS px.
Mobile long titles clamp in rows while the browser interaction check opens their complete text in EvidenceDrawer.
Task review actions remain visible at 390 CSS px; three task categories remain distinct.
Locked state explicitly retains uncertainty and does not present unknown data as zero.
